title: Her Memories: Homecoming Queen
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
steps: Walk into present-day Southern San d'Oria from East Ronfaure to start the memory scene.
Complete the three child quests in any order: Old Bean, The Faux Pas and Grave Resolve.
Their three tiny fragments combine automatically into Large memory fragment I; no additional hand-in is required.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: Old Bean
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
steps: Speak with Thierride inside the Rusty Anchor Pub (G-7) for Thierride's bean creation.
Speak with Amaura in Southern San d'Oria (G-6) and finish the scene about the dish.
Return to Thierride for the memory fragment.
reward: A tiny memory fragment toward Large memory fragment I.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: The Faux Pas
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
steps: Speak with Abioleget in the cathedral at (M-7).
Speak with Bertenont at (E-4) and finish the scene to receive the fragment.
reward: A tiny memory fragment toward Large memory fragment I.

title: Her Memories: Grave Resolve
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
steps: Speak with Halver (I-9) for the scene.
Reach the Weathered Gravestone in present-day Batallia Downs (I-10). Examine it first, then trade one Lilac to finish the memory. The native handler requires the examination before the trade.
reward: A tiny memory fragment toward Large memory fragment I.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: Of Malign Maladies
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
steps: Speak with Amaura (G-6), then Monberaux in Upper Jeuno (G-10).
Examine the Library Book on the eastern wall of the Optistery in northern Windurst Waters (G-7).
Trade one Philosopher's Stone to the Fey Blossoms in Witchfire Glen, Grauberg [S] (F-5).
Leave the zone and wait until the next Vana'diel day. Return to the Fey Blossoms and examine them for the Fey stone.
Report to Raustigne in Southern San d'Oria [S] (I-7) for the fragment.

title: Her Memories: Operation Cupid
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
One each of Rice Vinegar, Ground Wasabi and Holy Basil.
steps: Walk into Batallia Downs [S] from Jugner Forest [S] for the scene.
Examine the Bulwark Gate in Sauromugue Champaign [S], then visit Leadavox in Vunkerl Inlet [S] (J-6).
Trade Rice Vinegar, Ground Wasabi and Holy Basil together to Leadavox for a Pot of martial relish.
Examine the Bulwark Gate again. Finally, enter Batallia Downs [S] from Rolanberry Fields [S] for the fragment.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: Carnelian Footfalls
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
The San d'Oria past-allegiance branch of Her Memories.
steps: While allied with the Iron Rams, enter Southern San d'Oria [S] from East Ronfaure [S] for the memory scene. Speak with Mainchelite at (I-9).
Walk back into East Ronfaure [S] for another scene.
Examine the three Steamed Rams ??? locations: (H-8), the dirt hollow northeast of the fort; northwest (I-8), beneath the waterfall; and northwest (J-7), beside the tree.
Return to Mainchelite for the fragment.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: Azure Footfalls
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
The Bastok past-allegiance branch of Her Memories.
steps: While allied with Bastok, enter Bastok Markets [S] from North Gustaberg [S], then speak with Adelbrecht at (E-8).
In North Gustaberg [S], speak with Gebhardt (I-6) on the first level of Zegham Hill, then Roderich (E-11).
Examine the Barricade at (E-7), then return to Adelbrecht for the fragment.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.

title: Her Memories: Verdure Footfalls
requirements: Her Memories is the current Wings of the Goddess mission.
The Windurst past-allegiance branch of Her Memories.
steps: Enter Windurst Waters [S] from West Sarutabaruta [S] for a scene, then speak with Miah Riyuh at (H-9) on the northern map.
Visit the three towers in West Sarutabaruta [S], at (J-8), (F-11), and (F-4). Examine each Sealed Entrance.
Return to Miah Riyuh for the fragment.
era_note: September 2010 WotG memory chapter, released after the original level-75 cap.
availability_note: Reference walkthrough: no Verdure Footfalls quest handler or Windurst zone fallback was found in the pinned source. Do not expect this branch to complete on an unmodified core.
